expression.description: Use [column] references, JSON double-quoted strings, numeric/boolean/null literals and only the listed functions. Arithmetic including + is numeric-only, never text concatenation. There is no concat function or general column-to-column text concatenation. To add a constant text suffix/prefix, use regex_replace with a literal replacement and an anchored pattern. Regex options must be explicit string literals; replacement supports Python-style capture references, not expressions or column interpolation. Use temporal_format for typed temporal values first, or temporal_parse explicitly to create a temporal value from text. Missing inputs follow nullPolicy; coalesce can supply a compatible fallback. Numeric predicates inspect the already represented int64/float64 value, not an original decimal string. float64 parsing can round decimal fractions and large integers; these predicates cannot recover lost source precision. is_finite does not suppress errors in argument expressions. Columns float64 conversion rejects invalid/nonfinite/overflow text; castFailure null converts those failures to null, while castFailure error stops. Retain original text explicitly before conversion. Typed table values are normally already finite; null after parsing is not a finite value. This is not arbitrary-precision decimal or financial arithmetic.

x-functionSignatures.is_finite: is_finite(number) -> bool; one int64/float64 argument; null stays null; strings/bools refused; no implicit parsing
x-functionSignatures.is_integer: is_integer(number) -> bool; finite represented value has no fractional part; no int64 conversion/range restriction; null stays null; strings/bools refused
x-functionSignatures.require: require(condition, value) -> original scalar type; only Boolean true passes, false or null stops execution; both arguments are evaluated; use a preceding Filter for unsafe arithmetic
x-functionSignatures.coalesce: coalesce(value, fallback, ...) -> compatible scalar type; 2–16 arguments
x-functionSignatures.regex_replace: regex_replace(text, pattern, replacement, occurrence, flags) -> string; occurrence: first|all
x-functionSignatures.regex_match: regex_match(text, pattern, matchMode, flags) -> bool; matchMode: search|full
x-functionSignatures.regex_extract: regex_extract(text, pattern, matchMode, noMatch, flags, group, ...) -> ordered string outputs; matchMode: search|full; noMatch: null|error; group: quoted group number or name
x-functionSignatures.temporal_parse: temporal_parse(text, dtype, pattern, sourceTimezone, resultTimezone, invalid, ambiguous, nonexistent, version) -> dtype; version: v1; dtype: date|datetime|time; invalid: stop|missing; ambiguous: stop|earliest|latest|missing; nonexistent: stop|missing
x-functionSignatures.temporal_part: temporal_part(temporal, part, timezone) -> int64; part must be supported for the input temporal type
x-functionSignatures.temporal_difference: temporal_difference(leftTemporal, rightTemporal, unit, representation) -> int64|float64; matching temporal types; representation: integer|decimal
x-functionSignatures.decimal_parse: decimal_parse(decimal text) -> canonical decimal text; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_is_finite: decimal_is_finite(decimal text) -> bool; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_is_integer: decimal_is_integer(decimal text) -> bool; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_abs: decimal_abs(decimal text) -> canonical decimal text; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_add: decimal_add(decimal text, decimal text) -> canonical decimal text; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_subtract: decimal_subtract(decimal text, decimal text) -> canonical decimal text; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_multiply: decimal_multiply(decimal text, decimal text) -> canonical decimal text; exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly
x-functionSignatures.decimal_compare: decimal_compare(decimal text, decimal text) -> int64 (-1/0/1); exact original text, no binary float conversion; null propagates; malformed/nonfinite parse becomes missing and predicates false; invalid arithmetic or processing allowance fails explicitly

configSchema.description: Ordered typed column formulas. Structural workflow validation does not evaluate expressions against actual upstream column types; run-time preparation validates types before publishing output. Operations may reference preceding outputs. Output dtype must match the expression; it does not cast a value. Temporal output support does not establish downstream Partition or model mapping support.

operators.title: Text encoding
operators.description: Encode text into token IDs or fit Training-only TF-IDF preparation for sparse document classification. Preserve document identities and frozen vocabulary for held-out data.
